title: Open Frequency scene 001 — radio studio night

summary_reference: At night in a rain-hit community radio studio, four distinct team members work around old consoles, a tape reel, a battered mixer, and a whiteboard; a portable antenna and dented lantern arrive as they struggle to get the station live.
continuity_notes: The four-person ensemble and the studio equipment remain visually coherent across the submitted frames.
